reviewer_summary.question: Why must a chosen word be processed before choosing the following word, and how do separate layer caches save work?
reviewer_summary.takeaway: Choosing blue uses is’s finished number; processing blue makes its own finished number, while saved keys and values let it reuse earlier preparation.
